evidence: DB provenance.current_factorial: for the p50-forecast policy at rho=15, issue-time actuation, realizable leads {15,30,45,165}s, the strict re-warm readiness model clears 23/60 cells and the warm-pool model clears 24 feasible cells -- exactly the '23-24 of 60' factorial the anchor cites. The '60 cells' denominator = 5 windows x 3 TSFMs x 4 leads (closedloop.tex L69-71). p50 also fails the calm day (p99 ~1073ms) per the same view. Query: SELECT readiness,count(*),sum(feasible::int) FROM current_factorial WHERE quantile='p50' AND rho=15 AND actuation='issue-time' AND lead_s IN (15,30,45,165) GROUP BY readiness.
